title: KHR_character_skeleton_mapping glTF Document Extension
description: Associates roles from versioned skeletal vocabularies with glTF nodes.

skeletalRigMappings.description: Nonempty dictionary of skeletal vocabulary mappings. Each key is an absolute URI identifying a version-stable vocabulary; each value associates that vocabulary's role identifiers with glTF nodes.

additionalProperties.description: Nonempty role-association dictionary. Each key is a nonempty role identifier defined by the mapping set's vocabulary; each value is a node association.
